title: Field Guide: Polite Reactions & Social Courtesies

words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 请问洗手间在哪儿？(Qǐngwèn xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?) — Excuse me, where is the restroom?
明天会降温？是吗，那我多穿点。(Míngtiān huì jiàngwēn? Shì ma, nà wǒ duō chuān diǎnr.) — Temperature dropping tomorrow? Is that so, I'll bundle up.
要喝水吗？— 不用了，谢谢。(Yào hē shuǐ ma? — Bú yòng le, xièxie.) — Want water? — No thank you.

words.English Meaning: let me think / let me consider
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这个提议很好，让我想一下。(Zhè ge tíyì hěn hǎo, ràng wǒ xiǎng yíxià.) — Good suggestion, let me think about it.

words.English Meaning: could you please / bother you to
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 麻烦你帮我递一下那本书。(Máfan nǐ bāng wǒ dì yíxià nà běn shū.) — Could you bother to pass me that book?
借过借过，请大家让一让。(Jièguò jièguò, qǐng dàjiā ràng yí ràng.) — Excuse me passing through, please let me pass.
为了我们的友谊，干杯！(Wèile wǒmen de yǒuyì, gānbēi!) — Cheers to our friendship!
您的中文讲得真好！— 哪里哪里，还在学。(Nín de zhōngwén jiǎng de zhēn hǎo! — Nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, hái zài xué.) — Your Chinese is great! — Not at all, still learning.
不好意思打扰了，我想问个路。(Bù hǎoyìsi dǎrǎo le, wǒ xiǎng wèn ge lù.) — Sorry to disturb you, I wanted to ask for directions.
祝贺你顺利通过了考试！(Zhùhè nǐ shùnlì tōngguò le kǎoshì!) — Congratulations on passing your exam smoothly!
天气变冷了，多保重身体。(Tiānqì biàn lěng le, duō bǎozhòng shēntǐ.) — Weather is getting colder, take care of your health.

words.English Meaning: take care on your way out (host to guest)
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 吃好喝好了，您慢走，常来啊！(Chī hǎo hē hǎo le, nín màn zǒu, cháng lái a!) — Hope you enjoyed it, take care, come again!
您的菜齐了，请慢用。(Nín de cài qí le, qǐng màn yòng.) — All your dishes are here, please enjoy your meal.
非常抱歉让您久等了。(Fēicháng bàoqiàn ràng nín jiǔděng le.) — Very sorry to have kept you waiting so long.
都是老朋友了，别那么客气。(Dōu shì lǎo péngyou le, bié nàme kèqi.) — We're old friends, don't be so formal.

words.English Meaning: have a pleasant journey / bon voyage
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 明天坐飞机回国？祝你一路顺风！(Míngtiān zuò fēijī huíguó? Zhù nǐ yílù shùnfēng!) — Flying home tomorrow? Bon voyage!
欢迎光临，请问几位？(Huānyíng guānglín, qǐngwèn jǐ wèi?) — Welcome, table for how many?
我是新来的实习生，请多指教。(Wǒ shì xīn lái de shíxíshēng, qǐng duō zhǐjiào.) — I am a new intern, please give me your guidance.
有什么需要帮忙的，随时效劳。(Yǒu shénme xūyào bāngmáng de, suíshí xiàoláo.) — Whatever help you need, at your service anytime.
及时提醒，多谢多谢！(Jíshí tíxǐng, duōxiè duōxiè!) — Timely reminder, many thanks!
